user.title: Choose your location
user.description: Pick a point on the map. The nearest Bureau of Meteorology forecast towns will be listed next.

data_description.location: Defaults to your Home Assistant home location.

town.title: Choose a forecast town
town.description: The Bureau of Meteorology issues town forecasts for these places, nearest first.

station.title: Choose an observation station
station.description: Current conditions come from a Bureau of Meteorology weather station. These stations are nearest to {location}.

reconfigure.title: Change observation station
reconfigure.description: Choose the weather station that provides current conditions for {location}.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Bureau of Meteorology. Check your internet connection and that FTP (port 21) is not blocked.
error.station_unavailable: This station is not reporting at the moment. Choose another station.

abort.already_configured: This forecast town is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Bureau of Meteorology. Check your internet connection and that FTP (port 21) is not blocked.
abort.no_stations: No observation stations were found near this town.

data_description.forecast_days: Number of days to create daily forecast sensors for: 0 creates none, 1 is today and 2 adds tomorrow. The weather entity always includes the full 7-day forecast.

observation_failed.message: Error fetching observations from the Bureau of Meteorology: {error}

daily_forecast_failed.message: Error fetching the daily forecast from the Bureau of Meteorology: {error}

hourly_forecast_failed.message: Error fetching the hourly forecast from the Bureau of Meteorology: {error}

warnings_failed.message: Error fetching warnings from the Bureau of Meteorology: {error}

rate_limited.message: The Bureau of Meteorology is rate limiting requests. Retrying later.

station_unavailable.title: Weather station {station} is not reporting
station_unavailable.description:
The Bureau of Meteorology weather station {station} used for current conditions in {location} is not reporting. It may be temporarily offline or decommissioned.

If it does not recover, go to **Settings > Devices & services > Bureau of Meteorology (Australia)**, open the {location} entry menu and choose **Reconfigure** to pick another station.
